recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. No separate source change is needed here for FHIR-27812 or FHIR-43354; revisit only if a future work-group decision changes the conformance level or safety guidance for mandatory/modifier elements returned by _elements.
issue_request: FHIR-31655 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked who is responsible for ensuring mandatory and modifier elements are returned when a client uses _elements, because the search page mixed client-side responsibility wording with server-side SHOULD guidance. The approved resolution replaced the old 'Only elements' and 'Clients SHOULD list' text with an expected-elements and server-discretion clarification.
initial_application: Commit 181332c6aeedcdd4d32c68a53fd3438041e6556c added the expected-elements list to source/search.html, but left the two sentences the Jira resolution said to replace. The current source therefore still contained the old client-side responsibility language alongside the newer server-discretion language.
additional_context: FHIR-27812 is the same _elements mandatory/modifier guidance family and established that the server-side SHOULD guidance should mention modifier elements as well as mandatory elements, so that text was preserved. FHIR-43354 later removed 'always' from the server SHOULD sentence and added the note that _elements can be used outside search; that later applied wording was also preserved. FHIR-I minutes confirmed the 2021 vote, and a later implementers Zulip thread was consistent with _elements being a request to filter rather than an absolute minimal-payload promise.
reconciliation: Changed source/search.html in the active FHIR-core search page _elements section. The edit removes the obsolete 'Only elements that are listed' and 'Clients SHOULD list' wording, keeps the approved expectation list, corrects the local 'explicity' typo while editing that list, and leaves the later REST API note and server SHOULD guidance unchanged.
source_changes: source/search.html: replaced the stale _elements list-only/client SHOULD wording with the approved expected-elements wording and server-discretion sentence; corrected 'explicity' in the edited list.

related_jiras.note: Established related server-side guidance that _elements responses should include modifier elements as well as mandatory elements; this reconciliation preserves that current server SHOULD text.
Later clarification removed 'always' from the same server SHOULD sentence and added the RESTful API note; that applied wording is already represented on the combined branch and was preserved.
